rxz · VFX + SFX
===============

Two Claude Code skills for Roblox, in one folder. Free.

1. Open the skills folder and copy BOTH folders inside it:
   roblox-vfx     roblox-sfx

   into the folder Claude Code reads:
     Windows         C:\Users\<you>\.claude\skills
     macOS / Linux   ~/.claude/skills

   (Create .claude\skills if it is not there yet. In Explorer, type the path
   into the address bar of any window and press Enter.)

2. Restart Claude Code.

3. Ask for the result, not the script:
     "sound my game: footsteps, gunshots, a UI click"
     "harvest the VFX in this place and build me an ice ring"

No PowerShell, no admin, no install button, no key, no account.

If Claude says it cannot find the skill, the folder is one level too deep. It
must be exactly:
  .claude\skills\roblox-vfx\SKILL.md
  .claude\skills\roblox-sfx\SKILL.md

Nothing else to do. The VFX skill makes its own library at
~/Roblox-VFX-Library the first time it needs it.
